selection: first fully available candidate; requested family may narrow selection

candidates.license_evidence: The installed font metadata identifies the STIX license, derived from the SIL Open Font License. The renderer records hashes but does not copy these system files into the repository.
candidates.legal_installation: Install the STIX Fonts project from its official distribution, then update paths if the operating system stores it elsewhere. Confirm the specific distribution's license before publication.

candidates.license_evidence: ReportLab distributes these files with bitstream-vera-license.txt. The renderer refers to the installed dependency and does not copy the font into this repository.
candidates.legal_installation: Install ReportLab from its official Python distribution and retain its bundled Bitstream Vera license.

publication_note: STIXGeneral is the preferred serif. Bitstream Vera is an operational fallback, not the preferred devotional typography. A target-market production release still requires a pinned font package and legal review.
